story: My whole life, I’ve dealt with dry skin, and finding a routine that actually worked for me was always a struggle. I tried lotions, oils, and scrubs, and over time I realized that what was out there just wasn’t working for my skin. So instead of searching for the right product, I decided to create my own.

I started researching, mixing, and testing natural oils and butters until I made something I was proud of. When a stubborn, dry, discolored spot on my back cleared up after using my shea butter, I knew I had something worth sharing. In October 2021, I launched A Gabrielle.

Running my business while going to school and working full time taught me a lot. Most of all, I realized I didn’t want to just sell anything. I wanted to give you something I truly believed in. So I took a step back.

I was planning to relaunch in 2025, but in August of that year, all of my accounts were hacked, and I lost everything I had created and built online. I’ll be honest: I got discouraged. I didn’t know what this would look like for me anymore. I could have let that stop me, but I didn’t give up. I chose to rebuild from the ground up and stick to what I started.

After a few years of ups and downs, I’m so grateful to be back. Whether you’ve been with me from the beginning or you’re just finding out about me, thank you. I can’t wait for you to fall in love with your skin.
